counterexamples.finding: Robustness concerns optimal fair accuracy value under known distributions; not identity/stability of a selected classifier or arbitrary finite-sample learner. DP constant depends on nonzero group masses;EO/PE require nonzero group-label masses. Results treat each criterion separately, not simultaneous equalized odds/predictive parity/general fairness. At-most-one randomized point is supported for two-group single-linear-constraint setting; multigroup footnote does not justify the same one-point bound universally.

0.5gain is extremal construction/supremum, not empirical gain. NP-completeness formally concerns a rational finite-input decision problem, optimization should be called NP-hard. FutureWork explicitly requests empirical validation; hate-speech example not a new experiment or deployment study. Generalized cost-sensitive/multigroup remarks are not separately fully proved here.

Claim1constant-label loss/accuracy signs and best label inconsistent;Lemma1mass-addition minimum sign needs correction. Some displayed unfairness differences omit absolute value though PDF has it in several places. Claim4uses fixed0.05 and inconsistent delta rather than explicit arbitrarily small-eps family; generalize only after checking. EO f0 accepts score1 but zeroTPR should concern score0; duplicatedA/Ddenominators/corollaryPElabels need cleanup. The event proof excludes changes to already-score0/1 cells by a claim of unchangedscore, requiring clarification for arbitrary label perturbation. These are research questions, not adopted style rules or proof certification.
